vals_gpqa.protocol: Diamond subset of 198 questions; two prompting approaches (zero-shot CoT, few-shot CoT); published 'overall' panel = derived average of the two CoT protocols (per Benchmark Atlas mirror description); canonical page shows separate diamond_zero_shot_cot / few-shot panels per model
vals_gpqa.exact_text: As in the original paper, this benchmark uses two evaluation approaches: Zero-shot chain-of-thought ... Few-shot chain-of-thought ... We focus on the 'diamond' subset of 198 questions
